UoA Assistant
The UoA Assistant is an AI-powered chatbot to help you quickly find answers and provide support throughout your university journey.
The UoA Assistant uses generative AI allowing for accurate responses and context awareness, while accessing information from University sites including the main website, course outlines and AskAuckland.
You can find the UoA Assistant in the bottom right-hand corner of your screen on any page on the University website.
Tips for interacting with the UoA Assistant
Be specific:
Clearly state your question or what you need help with.
Provide context:
Share any relevant details that can help the assistant understand your query better.
Ask one question at a time:
This helps the assistant give you focused and accurate answers.
Avoid sharing sensitive information:
This includes personal details or addresses.
We take your privacy seriously, so feel free to review our policy on
AI assistants at the University
.
